boundary: These are candidate shared presentation contracts. Current Plans/Shared_Integration_Runtime.md owns shared installation/lifecycle, continuation, coalescing, ObservableWork, and resource-governance mechanics; Plans/CLI_Bridged_Providers.md, Plans/Release_Supply_Chain.md, Models, Multi-Account, Permissions/FileSafe, and GUI owners retain their named policy and surface semantics. Concept-specific layout, question, activity, history, artifact, type, and motion grammars remain deliberately separate. No shared component may turn Auto/On into provider first-acquisition consent or imply bundling without a later named user-approved exception.

candidates.shared_contract: stable selected thread/window/thread-concept ids; thread-local view; route/access/BSD/context projections; question and operational projections
candidates.must_not_own: Thread Service, Goal, route, permission, outbox, artifact, or notification truth

candidates.shared_contract: stable messages, slices, lineage, current revision, exact range fetch and anchor ids
candidates.must_not_own: retention, canonical storage, search index or server subscription

candidates.must_not_own: message rendering grammar or thread-specific spatial composition

candidates.must_not_own: concept-specific placement, typography, or activity composition

candidates.shared_contract: sent/worked/elapsed/mode/provider/model/effort/persona/tokens/context and source quality
candidates.must_not_own: provider accounting, Usage settlement, or Persona definitions

explicit_non_extractions: The eight window spatial systems remain independent.
The eight thread reading, question, activity, history, artifact, typography, and motion grammars remain independent.
Cards are not normalized into a universal card system; only semantic decision and system-boundary contracts are candidates.
The deterministic prototype reducer is not a runtime owner and is not proposed for production reuse.
